rules: Return strict JSON only. No markdown.
You may improve executive language, sequencing, and business framing.
Keep each rewritten field concise. Prefer one or two direct sentences.
Do not invent facts, dollar values, funding status, readiness, realized value, ROI, savings, finance attestation, or production readiness.
Do not expose raw source IDs, file names, adapter IDs, or internal schema labels in user-facing prose.
Do not use V6, V7, dossier, projection, substrate, bridge, or runtime jargon.
Candidate AI opportunities must remain a portfolio, not one selected hero use case.
Promised value is not realized value. AI spend is non-additive unless explicitly stated otherwise.

story_blocks_to_rewrite.title: Meridian's V3 context is broad enough to orient executives, but still planning-grade.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.executive_summary: Meridian's V3 packet now carries source-backed healthcare context across 19 core files, 3 source adapters, and 221 interview rows. It is strong enough to browse the enterprise context and frame next decisions, but not to claim production readiness or realized value.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.business_meaning: Home should act as the context browser: what is known, what is sourced, what remains a gap, and what can be sent to Intelligence, Moves, Source, or Tower.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.what_context_reveals: The packet describes enterprise profile, functions, applications, vendors, risks, programs, metrics, interviews, budget rows, program portfolio rows, and benefits validation rows.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.why_it_matters: A CIO/CFO can see whether the evidence base is ready for advisory use before asking aVa to make recommendations.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.evidence_boundary: This is synthetic demo context and must stay source-backed. No production readiness, realized value, or finance-attested claim is implied.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.recommended_next_action: Use Home to inspect evidence coverage and send only validated slices to Intelligence or Tower.

story_blocks_to_rewrite.title: The strongest context is the governed enterprise, technology, finance, and interview spine.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.executive_summary: The packet includes 4298 canonical facts, 4298 evidence registry entries, 1214 entity profiles, and 902 relationship edges. That is enough for Home to orient a CXO, while still showing what remains validation-grade rather than production truth.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.business_meaning: The context is broad enough to browse Meridian's operating model, technology estate, budget posture, programs, risks, metrics, and interview themes in one place.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.what_context_reveals: Coverage is strongest where source rows tie to evidence IDs and relationship edges; it is weaker where benefits depend on actual usage, KPI, or finance validation.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.why_it_matters: A CXO needs to know which answers can be grounded immediately and which require more evidence before a decision meeting.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.evidence_boundary: Context strength is a browsing/readiness signal, not a claim that every source is complete or production-attested.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.recommended_next_action: Use gaps and evidence coverage to decide what to validate before forwarding a slice to Intelligence or Tower.

story_blocks_to_rewrite.title: Nexus knows the Meridian context as connected source-backed facts, not as one flat file list.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.executive_summary: The source packet spans enterprise profile, business functions, owners, workforce roles, systems, data assets, infrastructure, vendors, budget, programs, AI opportunities, risks, relationships, evidence, metrics, industry patterns, expert lenses, managed services, operational process evidence, finance adapters, program adapters, benefits ledger rows, and interviews.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.business_meaning: Home should make that context browsable and explainable without turning every row into an advisory answer.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.what_context_reveals: The practical value is the ability to inspect facts, evidence, relationships, and gaps before deciding what is safe to ask aVa to synthesize.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.why_it_matters: This prevents the system from jumping straight to recommendation mode before the user understands what evidence is actually available.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.evidence_boundary: Home knows only what the packet contains; advisory conclusions belong in Intelligence, Moves, Source, and Tower.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.recommended_next_action: Keep Home scoped to context browsing and use module handoff only for evidence-backed slices.

story_blocks_to_rewrite.title: AI opportunities should be treated as a portfolio, not as one selected solution.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.executive_summary: The source packet contains 242 candidate or discovery AI opportunity rows across member service, claims, clinical operations, revenue cycle, workforce productivity, IT operations, cybersecurity, and data/analytics. Candidate rows remain unfunded unless explicit source rows show approved funding.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.business_meaning: Home can show where AI ideas exist and which evidence is missing, while Moves later selects and shapes business cases.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.what_context_reveals: Member Service AI Assist is only one candidate; it is not the default hero and does not inherit platform spend.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.why_it_matters: This avoids accidentally turning embedded platform spend into a funded AI business case.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.evidence_boundary: Candidate AI rows with funding_status not_approved remain opportunity-only.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.recommended_next_action: Prioritize evidence requests by business unit, baseline availability, PHI/control needs, and measurement readiness.

story_blocks_to_rewrite.title: The gaps are decision blockers, not cosmetic data-quality notes.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.executive_summary: The derived layer surfaced 2752 context gaps across evidence, baselines, finance validation, controls, data lineage, workflow maps, value-claim validation, candidate funding, program-budget ties, and AI duplicate-counting risk.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.business_meaning: AbarVa should help the CXO see which missing inputs prevent board-grade decisions.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.what_context_reveals: The most important gaps are not missing names; they are missing actuals, baselines, validation, control posture, and lineage.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.why_it_matters: Those gaps determine whether an insight can become a funded move or a Tower value claim.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.evidence_boundary: Gap visibility must not be hidden behind high confidence language.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.recommended_next_action: Group gaps by owner and request evidence before presenting finance or operational outcomes.

story_blocks_to_rewrite.title: The same source packet supports different modules at different levels of maturity.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.executive_summary: Home is ready as a context browser; Intelligence can synthesize sourced advisory context; Tower is budget/readiness-safe but value-claim gated; Moves can shape candidate opportunities; Source is outside this Meridian build unless a sourcing event is loaded.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.business_meaning: The product should not imply every module has the same evidence strength just because the packet exists.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.what_context_reveals: Budget, candidate opportunity, and benefits posture are useful, but each has a different decision boundary.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.why_it_matters: A CIO/CFO demo works only if the page is honest about what can be trusted now versus what needs validation.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.evidence_boundary: Module readiness is source-derived and must stay separate from runtime production readiness.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.recommended_next_action: Use the readiness map to route questions to the right module and keep unsupported asks out of Home.

story_blocks_to_rewrite.title: The next data ask should close decision gates, not add bulk.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.executive_summary: The highest-value next evidence requests are usage exports for AI-enabled platforms, KPI actuals, finance validation, workflow maps, PHI/control attestations, source-system lineage, and owner signoff for benefit claims.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.business_meaning: This gives the client a practical intake list for moving from synthetic demo posture to client-validated use.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.what_context_reveals: Most blocked claims can be unblocked by targeted evidence rather than a full data dump.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.why_it_matters: That is the operating model for future tenant loads: source packet first, derived context second, decision-grade validation third.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.evidence_boundary: Evidence requests are not assertions that the evidence exists today.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.recommended_next_action: Assign each evidence request to a functional owner before using the content in an executive decision session.

story_blocks_to_rewrite.title: More evidence converts browsing context into decision-grade context.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.executive_summary: The main unlocks are baseline metrics, source-system lineage, usage extracts, finance validation, PHI/control evidence, and workflow maps.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.business_meaning: The next data request should be targeted; loading more files is less important than closing the evidence gaps that block decisions.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.what_context_reveals: Context gaps concentrate around baseline/actuals, value validation, data lineage, and candidate funding boundaries.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.why_it_matters: Those gaps determine whether Tower can make a value posture claim and whether Moves can turn a candidate use case into a funded program.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.evidence_boundary: Missing evidence remains visible rather than being converted into confidence theater.
story_blocks_to_rewrite.recommended_next_action: Ask owners for the specific evidence in the gap register before presenting value claims.
